name: assetpanda/thanks-calendly
title: AP Thanks Calendly
description: Booking card under a thank-you hero: the event (logo, name, duration, description) beside an inline Calendly scheduler. Several tracks can be given; the first whose sessionStorage rule matches is shown (live: 'transition' vs 'implementation' demo calendars by the visitor's current-solution answer), otherwise the default. Live: the legacy pricing / trial / demo thank-you pages (bs-section--thank-you-calendar). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
